name: sentry_get_issue
description: Retrieve full detail for a single Sentry issue: status, assignment, `count`, `userCount`, `firstSeen`/`lastSeen`, tag distributions, and metadata. Provide the issue's numeric `issue_id` (the `id` field from sentry_list_issues, not the shortId). For the actual stacktrace of the latest occurrence, use sentry_get_latest_event.

issue_id.description: The issue's numeric id (the `id` field from sentry_list_issues).
